messages:
Tasha: Heads-up — saw a small but consistent spike of customer requests failing with fncall validation errors after the 2am rollout. Error payload: `ValidationError: function_response does not match schema (missing 'result.items')`
Liam: ugh. Is this the strict-validate toggle we flipped for the canary? :grimacing:
Anya: yes, we enabled strict schema validation for fncall in <canary/variant-a> to cut down on silent tool failures. sampling rate 1% -> 100% for canary.
Kevin (SRE): Deploy bot shows a deploy at 02:05 to canary pool. ConsoleBot: deploy/variant-a succeeded (build 2026.03.12-02:04) :white_check_mark:
Tasha: The failures look like partial tool responses where the model returned an empty array for items instead of the object. It used to be coerced. Now we reject and surface an error back to the caller.
Liam: Are these user-facing errors or are we converting to a soft-fallback route? I thought we planned fallback->legacy-model for strict reverts.
Anya: For canary it was strict reject (hard) to measure regressions. We didn't configure an auto-rollforward/fallback in the route policy for that variant. My bad.
Kevin (SRE): Impact looks limited but noisy: ~0.2% of requests in region eu-west are hitting validators and returning 400s. Storage of traces doubled due to full payload captures. Cost + ops noise.
Tasha: Two concerns: UX (customers see 400s) and telemetry fidelity — our current sampling only logs reject counts, not the minimal failing example which is needed for debug.
Liam: Proposal: quick rollback of strict flag for canary and add permissive-coerce path with a metric tag 'coerced=true' so we can measure quality regression without breaking callers. Rollback should be small window 10m.
Anya: Agreed. To avoid reintroducing silent failures we add a console dashboard tile showing: reject_count, coerced_count, avg_latency, affected_route_ids. Also add a de-identified example payload sampler (1 in 500) with PII scrubber.
ConsoleTeam: We can add a dashboard panel and a rejection heatmap by route. Need metric names and label conventions. Suggest: "fncall.rejects.strict_v=variant-a" and "fncall.coerce.count" with route_id and model_variant tags.
Kevin (SRE): Also we should throttle how many full payloads go to retention logs. Current tracer captures full request for every reject. Change to sampled capture + size cap 64KB.
Tasha: I can open a quick rollback PR and patch the routing policy to point canary->permissive with fallback tag. Who owns the telemetry changes?
Anya: I'll own the metric + sampler change. Liam can own the rollout policy update with the quick PR. ConsoleTeam, can you provision the dashboard?
Liam: On it. I'll cut PR with comment "revert strict fncall for canary until telemetry + fallback in place" and request @Anya for instrumentation review.
ConsoleTeam: We'll add the dashboard tile under "fncall/validation" and the reject example stream using the scrubber. ETA 2 hours.
ConsoleBot: incident-tracker: created INC-2026-042 with priority P2, assignees Tasha, Liam, Anya.
Tasha: Long-term follow-ups: 1) define canary policy checklist for strict validation (must include fallback route, telemetry sampling, dashboard, PII scrubber), 2) add an automaton that converts certain validation rejects to soft-fallbacks if the reject rate is below threshold, 3) update docs for SDK consumers about 400 behavior.
Anya: I'll add checklist to the rollout playbook and PR to docs.
Kevin (SRE): After rollback and dashboard patch let's keep strict on a limited internal-only variant for an hour to gather deterministic failures before graduating.
Liam: Rollback PR up in 5m. Tasha I might ping you for a quick approval to expedite. :thumbsup:
Tasha: Thanks team. Keep updates here. If we see >1% rejects after rollback we escalate to P1.
ConsoleBot: status update: rollback merged -> variant-a now uses permissive-coerce route (change set 2026.03.12-02:21).
Liam: Verified in eu-west test traffic: rejects dropped to near 0, coerced_count ~ 0.15% as expected. Dashboard panel now shows examples streaming (sanitized).
Anya: Captured a canonical failing example and filed OPT-487 with suggested model adapter fix to return items as object.
Tasha: Closing loop: add postmortem notes to INC-2026-042, include timeline, metric diffs, and action owners. Great reactive work. :tada:
